title: Create Addons And Additions
description: Create Addons And Additions is a lightweight modpack expanding around the create mod
body:
Create Addons And Additions

Create Addons And Additions is a lightweight modpack centered around the Create mod. Rather than adding large amounts of new content, the pack includes a small selection of Create addons and supporting mods that slightly expand Create's gameplay while keeping the experience familiar.

The goal is to provide a Create-focused experience with a few additional mechanics, quality-of-life features, and compatibility improvements without significantly changing the progression or feel of the base mod.
